csv_project_name: AE for Landfill Flare Replacement Project
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Paso Robles (City) is soliciting proposals from qualified design firms/consultants to design the capital improvements and prepare bid documents for the Landfill Flare Replacement Project. The purpose of the Landfill Flare Replacement Project is to provide a new landfill gas flare system which will include the installation and startup of a new landfill blower/flare unit, new connection to the existing landfill gas collection system and installation of new equipment. The requested professional services are evaluating siting and equipment alternatives, designing a replacement flare and associated facilities that will meet the City s permit requirements for the flare, preparing bid documents, and providing bid-phase services to support public bidding for the flare project.
